hardware: Namco Pac-Man, fixed 36x28 tiles, 8x8 chars, 16x16 sprites
source: decoded MAME graphics, videoram, colorram, spriteram, spriteram_2
limitations: Palette-based wall classification is heuristic, including attract-screen text.
Tunnel sprite wrap copies, cocktail flip, and all visual priority edge cases are not implemented.
Only the currently visible board is reconstructed; no inferred hidden level geometry.
SceneKit meshes use shared cached geometry and Metal; GPU instancing is not explicitly implemented.
